verdict: Google spend dropped sharply this week, cutting lead volume in half.
narrative: This period delivered 11 leads at a total spend of $2,395.61 — but the week ending August 7 saw lead volume fall 50% compared to the prior week, driven entirely by Google Ads going dark on multiple days (August 2–4 and August 6). All 11 tracked leads this period came from Meta, which held steady throughout. Google's budget is being reviewed and restored so daily delivery stops zeroing out. Separately, 76 open opportunities in your pipeline currently show zero appointments and zero closed jobs, which points to an intake gap that needs to be filled before additional ad spend will translate into booked revenue.
